evidence: Canonical Workload box, Hardware row (PDF p.70): '8×H100 (80 GB each [1P][FACT], 640 GB [1P][FACT] × 8 — the 8-GPU count is a [canonical scenario][ASSUMPTION] deployment-unit choice'. Table 4-2 Note 1 (PDF p.103): 'the 640 GB pool is arithmetic on the two ([1P][FACT] × 8), not a third independent value'. Table 7-1 (PDF p.164): '8 × the [1P][FACT] 80 GB per-part constant (NVIDIA H100 80 GB specification) → [1P][DERIVED]'. Table 7-2 note (PDF p.171): 'the 640 GB aggregate pool is [1P][DERIVED] from that constant at eight parts'.
issue: Evidence-label mismatch: the Canonical Workload box attaches [1P][FACT] to the 640 GB aggregate pool, while Note 1 of Table 4-2 explicitly says that pool is arithmetic ('not a third independent value') and Tables 7-1 and 7-2 label the identical quantity [1P][DERIVED]. By the Preface rule (PDF p.21) 'Arithmetic belongs on the epistemic-status axis', so a product of a fact and a scenario assumption cannot itself be [FACT]; as printed, the box implies NVIDIA publishes a 640 GB 8-GPU host figure.
fix_instruction: In the Canonical Workload box Hardware row (PDF p.70) rewrite the cell as '8×H100 (80 GB each [1P][FACT]; 640 GB pool = [1P][FACT] × 8 → [1P][DERIVED]; 8-GPU count [canonical scenario][ASSUMPTION])' so the pool carries [1P][DERIVED], matching Table 4-2 Note 1 and Tables 7-1/7-2.

evidence: Preface cross-reference rule (PDF p.23): 'Appendix A numbers its own sections with a letter suffix, so Appendix A § 9A means Appendix A, the section labelled 9A; the appendix's figures carry A.N.' Body uses four different section forms: PDF p.3 'Appendix A §10'; PDF p.74 'accessed 2026-08-30; A.10'; PDF p.100 'Appendix A's §A.7 (Fig A.2, vendor-relative KV/compute ratios)'; PDF p.63 'Appendix A §9A'. List of Figures (PDF p.9): 'A.3 A chronology of frontier AI systems, ~2017 to ~2026 ... 492'. Preface (PDF p.17): 'a superseding re-verification of the DeepSeek model-service status (Appendix A, A.3)'; also (PDF p.22) 'the dated note itself at Appendix A, A.6 or A.3'.
issue: Malformed and colliding Appendix A cross-references. (a) The stated convention requires a letter suffix on section labels ('§ 9A'), but the body writes '§10', 'A.10', '§A.7' and '§9A' — four incompatible forms for section references. (b) 'A.3' resolves to two different targets: List of Figures assigns A.3 to the chronology figure (printed p.492) while the Preface uses 'Appendix A, A.3' for a DeepSeek model-service status text note; the same collision exists for 'A.6' (Preface text note vs. figure numbering) even though List of Figures stops at A.5.
fix_instruction: Adopt one section form everywhere (e.g. 'Appendix A § 10A' style matching the stated 'letter suffix' rule) and convert every body instance ('Appendix A §10' p.3, 'A.10' p.74, '§A.7' p.100) to it; reserve bare 'A.N' for figures only, and rewrite the Preface's 'Appendix A, A.3' / 'A.6' / 'A.10' text-note references (PDF pp.17, 22) to the section form so they stop colliding with figure A.3 (PDF p.9).

evidence: Preface rule (PDF p.23): 'Do not repeat a chapter number after the chapter name — write Ch. 8 § 3 or § 8.3.3, not Ch. 8 § 8.3.3.' Violating instances: PDF p.48 'derived in Ch 4 §4.3 and carried in Table 4-2' and 'the ~64 GB runtime/workspace reserve that Ch 7 §7.1 states as an assumption'; PDF p.74 'Ch 7 §7.4 re-derives the per-token value for other geometries'; PDF p.125 'Chapter 14 §14.4 (Acceptance test for a quantized deployment)'; PDF p.142 'resident KV slots (Ch 4 §4.3, §4.6)'; PDF p.156 '6 hosts, Ch 4 §4.3)'. Correct bare forms also occur, e.g. PDF p.62 '(§4.3)' and PDF p.84 '(see §4.3 and Table 4-1)'.
issue: Recurrence of a house-rule violation: six references repeat the chapter number after the chapter name, exactly the form the Preface forbids. Under the book's own parsing rule ('§ N.M means Chapter N, Section M' plus 'the section number may stand alone'), 'Ch 7 §7.4' resolves to Chapter 7, Section 7.4 (= §7.7.4), which does not exist, instead of the intended §7.4; the same mis-resolution applies to 'Ch 4 §4.3' (should be Ch 4 §3), 'Ch 7 §7.1' and 'Chapter 14 §14.4'.
fix_instruction: Sweep all six instances and drop the chapter digit from the section specifier: 'Ch 4 §4.3' → 'Ch 4 § 3' (PDF pp.48, 142, 156), 'Ch 7 §7.1' → 'Ch 7 § 1' (p.48), 'Ch 7 §7.4' → 'Ch 7 § 4' (p.74), 'Chapter 14 §14.4' → 'Chapter 14 § 4' (p.125); leave already-correct forms such as 'Ch 8 §3.4' (PDF p.32) unchanged.

evidence: Prose (PDF p.121): 'with a 1% straggler cluster at 5.0 s [ILLUSTRATIVE synthetic mixture]'. Captions: Fig. 6.2 (PDF p.147) '[ILLUSTRATIVE synthetic profile]'; Fig. 4.1 (PDF p.118), Fig. 5.1 (PDF p.141), Fig. 6.1 (PDF p.144) and List of Figures entries (PDF pp.8–9) '[ILLUSTRATIVE conceptual]'. Preface rule (PDF p.20): 'A label pair always takes one item from each of the first two axes'; 'Every load-bearing quantitative claim carries Axes 1 and 2 as an inline pair (e.g. [1P][DERIVED])'. Contrast with correctly paired captions: PDF p.34 '[ILLUSTRATIVE][DERIVED]', PDF p.35 '[ILLUSTRATIVE][ASSUMPTION]', PDF p.54 '[ILLUSTRATIVE][DERIVED]', PDF p.168 '[ILLUSTRATIVE][DERIVED]'.
issue: Malformed evidence-label pairs: an Axis-1 provenance tag is followed by a free-text word ('conceptual', 'synthetic mixture', 'synthetic profile') instead of an Axis-2 value (FACT/DERIVED/ASSUMPTION/HYPOTHESIS/UNRESOLVED). The p.121 instance is the strongest case — it labels the quantitative inputs (median 0.8 s, σ, 1% at 5.0 s, N=10,000) that drive every subsequent percentile and mean computation, so by the Preface's own rule it must be [ILLUSTRATIVE][ASSUMPTION], and the computed percentiles must be [ILLUSTRATIVE][DERIVED]. The same deviation appears in four figure captions and two List of Figures entries while every other figure caption in the book uses a correct pair.
fix_instruction: Replace '[ILLUSTRATIVE synthetic mixture]' (PDF p.121) with '[ILLUSTRATIVE][ASSUMPTION]' for inputs and '[ILLUSTRATIVE][DERIVED]' for the computed percentiles; replace '[ILLUSTRATIVE synthetic profile]' (Fig. 6.2, p.147) and '[ILLUSTRATIVE conceptual]' (Figs. 4.1, 5.1, 6.1 at pp.118, 141, 144, plus List of Figures pp.8–9) with the appropriate Axis-2 tag, moving any descriptive word outside the brackets.

evidence: PDF p.153 (§6.3.4): '~18.6× oversubscribed (the datasheet-peak ~7.9 PFLOPS gives ~6.5×, the theoretical ceiling only; under case (ii), full-square attention, the same peak screens at ~22 hosts — Ch 8 §3), consistent with Ch 8's 19-host screen at this peak (case (i))'.
issue: Ambiguous referent producing two different host counts. The immediately preceding noun phrase is 'datasheet-peak ~7.9 PFLOPS', so 'the same peak' naturally binds to the capacity ceiling; under that reading case (ii) demand 40 × 1.51 ≈ 60.4 PFLOP/s ÷ 7.9 PFLOPS = 7.65 → 8 hosts, contradicting the stated 22. The intended referent is the 40 rps traffic peak at the same 35% MFU planning rate (60.4 ÷ 2.77 = 21.8 → 22), recoverable only from 'at this peak' two clauses later.
fix_instruction: Rewrite the parenthetical on PDF p.153 to name both quantities explicitly: '(the datasheet-peak ~7.9 PFLOPS gives ~6.5×, a theoretical ceiling only; under case (ii), full-square attention, the same 40 rps traffic peak at the same 35% MFU planning rate screens ~22 hosts — Ch 8 §3)'.
